metadata.source: State of New Jersey Local Finance Board & Woodland Park Borough Audits

controversies.title: Ratable Base Balance & Assessment Equalization (Woodland Park Borough)
controversies.entityInvolved: Woodland Park Borough Governing Body & Tax Assessor
controversies.summary: Passaic Valley Regional HS member; stable tax profile supported by Route 46 and Garret Mountain office campuses.
controversies.investigationDetails: Annual watchdog audit of municipal tax appeal exposure, commercial assessment accuracy, and county equalized tax distribution.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Homeowners bear 80.2% of all property taxes raised in Woodland Park Borough.
controversies.status: Monitored Under NJ DLGS & County Tax Board Guidelines

controversies.title: Public School District Budget Growth & S2 State Aid Adjustments
controversies.entityInvolved: Woodland Park Borough Board of Education
controversies.summary: Public education appropriations represent 52.4% of the composite property tax levy in Woodland Park Borough.
controversies.investigationDetails: Watchdog analysis of per-pupil spending ($21,400/student) and health benefit premium cost-sharing under Chapter 44.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Annual school tax increases are capped at 2% under statutory levy limits unless statutory health care or enrollment adjustments apply.
controversies.status: Under Annual State DOE User-Friendly Budget Review

controversies.title: Commercial Development Tax Abatements (PILOT Shift)
controversies.entityInvolved: Woodland Park Borough Municipal Redevelopment Agency
controversies.summary: Commercial PILOT agreements in Woodland Park Borough yield $142,535 in service fees while abating standard property taxes.
controversies.investigationDetails: Under NJ Long-Term Tax Exemption Law, municipal government retains 95% of PILOT revenues, leaving local school districts with 0% of payments.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Shifts an estimated $24.3 per homeowner annually in indirect education funding burden.
